observations.observed_result: Breadcrumb: Home / Translation. Heading: 'Product page content' with Save/Reset buttons. Description text: "Edit static content showing up on Shopify's product page." Sidebar location: Store Settings > Product Page Content.

~110 translatable static strings organized into 21 named sections: Personalization form (18 fields incl. Form header, Label of template options, Show/hide layer toggle, character/number limit warnings, dropdown placeholder, Reposition button, background/font/color/map-style option labels, location/time/constellation/Milky-Way/grid-line labels), Upload photo (16 fields: button labels, cropper popup buttons, error/warning messages), Generate Image Buttons & Messages (7 fields), Populate Photo Progress (4 fields), Text Input Validation (5 fields), Maps (2 fields), Scrabble (4 fields), Song Search (5 fields), Vector (3 fields), Route Maps (12 fields incl. Strava connect flow), Word search (4 fields), Word cloud (5 fields), Cross-sell Personalization (7 fields), Confirmation Checkbox (2 fields), Preview (2 fields), ATC buttons (1 field, 'Personalize' — note: labelled 'Some options only work with Campaigns by Product base'), Out of stock (1 field), Addon Charge (2 fields, support {{PRICE}}/{{VALUE}} placeholders), ATC Response messages (4 fields, 'Only work with Campaigns by Product base'), Cart (4 fields), Other (2 gallery tooltip fields). Every field shows its current default value pre-filled as the textbox value (English defaults, e.g. 'personalize', '{{ ARTWORK_NAME }} template', 'Select a background'). Several fields use {{PLACEHOLDER}} template variables explained in helper text below the field.

observations.element: Languages combobox — effect of switching selection
observations.observed_result: Selecting 'Vietnamese' in the combobox: (1) did NOT trigger any new network request (no additional GET/POST observed after the select action), (2) field values shown remained identical to the English defaults (e.g. 'Form header:' still showed 'personalize') since no Vietnamese override existed yet, (3) the portal's OWN UI language did NOT change — sidebar menu items (Home, Orders, Campaigns, etc.), page heading 'Product page content', and Save/Reset button labels all remained in English. This confirms the switcher only changes WHICH language's translation content is being edited in the form, not the portal's display language.

observations.observed_result: Save triggers PUT https://staging-api.teeinblue.com/api/instances/609/config-translations. Request body always includes the FULL English ('en') default dataset (~110 semantic keys like form_header_title, template_label, color_label, cross_sell_title, etc.) unchanged, PLUS the edited non-default locale ('vi') as a SPARSE object containing only the field(s) actually changed (here only {"form_header_title": "..."}). Response 200 echoes the same structure back. x-acting-user-id: 266 header present.

observations.element: Page heading, breadcrumb, sidebar label, description — route identity verification
observations.observed_result: Sidebar link text (under Extras): 'Dynamic Translations', href /artwork-translations. Breadcrumb: Home / Extras / Artwork translation. Page heading: 'Dynamic Translations' with Save/Reset buttons. Description: "Translate dynamic content (artworks & product base) to multiple languages." Info banner directly under the heading states the EXACT supported scope verbatim: "Currently support translating: Option Title in the personalization form, Product base and Variants name." CONFIRMED: /artwork-translations is indeed the 'Dynamic Translations' feature as described by the user — heading/sidebar text says 'Dynamic Translations', only the URL slug and breadcrumb leaf ('Artwork translation') differ in wording.

OBSERVED (verbatim from UI info banner): 'Option Title in the personalization form', 'Product base' (name), 'Variants name'. NOT OBSERVED in the UI text or anywhere else on this page: any explicit mention of 'layer placeholder' (as distinct from Option Title), 'artwork custom name' (as distinct from Product base/Option Title), or 'campaign custom name/label'. The bootstrap task's assumed scope (layer label/placeholder, artwork custom name, product base custom name, campaign custom name/label) is BROADER/DIFFERENTLY WORDED than what the product itself states supports translation. Do not treat the unobserved items as confirmed-absent — only confirmed as not stated/not observed in this pass.

Table has 2 columns: 'Default' (source/original text, freeform textbox) and the currently selected locale's name as the second column header (e.g. 'English' or 'Vietnamese' after switching) — an arrow (→) sits between the two textboxes per row. A trash-can icon button deletes a row. A '+ Add new translation' link appends a new blank row. One blank row exists by default when there are no saved entries yet. A 'Search...' box and 'Auto translate' button sit above the table (Auto translate not tested — see unknowns). Import/Export buttons sit top-right of the table.

Clicking 'Import' immediately opens a native OS file-chooser dialog (i.e. it is a file-upload control, not a dropdown/picker that lets you pick source entities from the Artworks/Product Base/Campaigns list pages). No file was selected — the chooser was cancelled to stay within SAFE mutation policy (unknown file format/import semantics = no clear cleanup path). Separately, the Artworks list page (/artworks) was visually confirmed to have its OWN 'Import' button (top-right, next to '+ New artwork'), but this was not clicked/tested and is very likely for importing new artwork designs, not translations — not confirmed either way.

observations.element: Save action — API + storage model (Dynamic Translations)
observations.observed_result: Save triggers POST https://staging-api.teeinblue.com/api/translations/bulk with body {"translations":[{"locale":"vi","name":"Vietnamese","data":{"<exact Default text>":"<translated text>"}}]}. Response 200 returns a created record: {"id":69,"user_id":266,"is_default":false,"locale":"vi","data":{...},"created_at":...,"name":"Vietnamese"}. This is a DIFFERENT storage model than Product Page Content: keys are the literal free-text source string typed into 'Default' (not a fixed semantic key), and only the changed locale's delta is sent (no full English payload echoed alongside, unlike config-translations). A GET https://staging-api.teeinblue.com/api/translations call was also observed around this time (likely the load-existing-entries call) but its response body was not captured.

observations.element: TASK-8 cleanup verification — Form header vi override
observations.observed_result: With locale=Vietnamese selected, clicking into the 'Form header:' textbox, Cmd+A + Backspace clears the field to empty, leaving only the placeholder text 'personalize' visible (the English default) as a hint — the UI allows the field to be left empty (no explicit 'reset to default' control needed, just clear it). Clicking Save sent PUT /api/instances/609/config-translations with the vi delta {"form_header_title":""}; the server echoed back {"form_header_title":null} in the 200 response, i.e. an empty string sent is persisted/normalized as null (no override). Reloading the page fresh and re-selecting Vietnamese confirms the field is empty (only placeholder 'personalize' shown, no visible value) — override is gone and persisted.

observations.element: TASK-8 cleanup verification — Dynamic Translations record id=69 deletion + GET /api/translations load call resolved
observations.observed_result: GET https://staging-api.teeinblue.com/api/translations (fired on page load) is confirmed as the load-existing-entries endpoint: before cleanup it returned a flat array [{"id":69,"user_id":266,"is_default":false,"locale":"vi","data":{"Vertical Framed Poster":"<test translation>"},...,"name":"Vietnamese"}]. Clicking the row's trash-can icon opens a confirm dialog verbatim 'Are you sure to remove Vertical Framed Poster?' with Remove/Cancel buttons; clicking Remove clears the row client-side only (no network call yet — same deferred-until-Save pattern as Product Page Content). Clicking the page-level Save button then sent POST /api/translations/bulk with body {"translations":[]} (i.e. the bulk endpoint replaces the FULL set of entries for the currently-selected locale, not a delete-by-id call) and got response []. Reloading the page and re-checking GET /api/translations returns [] and the table shows only the default single blank row (same empty-state as when there were never any entries) — record id=69 confirmed gone, no other locale/entries were touched.
